title: Sequential trigger Trojan in a gate-level controller
expected_output: A JSON file named trojan_report.json with the following schema: {"suspect_nodes": [{"node_name": "string", "role": "string"}]}

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: The proportion of true Trojan nodes (trigger DFFs and payload gate) correctly identified in the report.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: The proportion of reported suspect nodes that are not part of the actual Trojan.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: The wall-clock time taken by the evaluation script to grade the submission, measured in seconds.
